messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick sync — we need a clear handoff + account mapping process for SI co-sell leads, esp. marketplace and hardware partner referrals. Trying to avoid duplicate outreach and lost opps.
raj (sales): +1. Seen this bite us last quarter — two teams reached the same customer, awkward.
alex (salesops): what are the data sources we should map? marketplace leads, partner-referral form, HW partner AM lists, and inbound SDRs?
kelly (solutions): also technical introductions matter. If SI is doing infra pre-sales, we should auto-cc solutions for a baseline tech brief.
sara (si-engage): proposing a simple rule set: 1) if partner-originated (referral OR marketplace), partner retains primary contact for 30 days; 2) sales owns contract/commercial follow-up; 3) if both partner+redwood engage, use co-owned opp with designated lead.
tyler (legal): watch co-sell credit paperwork for HW partners — need EULA appendix signed before partner is "primary" in SFDC.
alex (salesops): Suggested tags in SFDC: si_origin, partner_name, marketplace_listing, hw_partner. Also add a custom field: partner_lead_owner (email).
maria (partnerships): here's a minimal mapping example — paste into the playbook and we'll iterate:
```
account_name,org_id,region,source,partner_name,partner_owner,redwood_owner,handoff_window_days
Acme Corp,ACME-001,APAC,marketplace,CloudVendor,naomi@cloudvendor.com,raj@redwood.com,30
BetaFin,BETA-420,EMEA,partner-referral,HWCo,leila@hwco.com,kelly@redwood.com,30
```
raj (sales): how do we resolve conflicts where a field rep already owns the account but partner claims referral?
sara (si-engage): tie-breaker logic: (a) documented referral timestamp wins; (b) if no timestamp, partner with signed referral form or marketplace lead token wins; (c) if still ambiguous, escalate to partnerships@redwood for arbitration.
alex (salesops): I'll create a validation rule in SFDC to require "referral_token" for partner-claimed leads and auto-assign to partner queue if present.
maria (partnerships): SLA proposal: partner-origin leads must be ACKed within 48 hours by Redwood owner and first outreach within 5 business days. Failures auto-notify @sales-ops and partner-owner.
kelly (solutions): for SI-engaged deals we should always include a "tech-brief" call within first 10 days. I'll add a calendar template.
tyler (legal): quick note — for HW partners reselling, we need reseller addendum signed before revenue recognition. Add a pipeline checkbox.
raj (sales): can we also ensure marketplace-sourced leads carry an attribution token so referral credit flow is clear?
alex (salesops): yep — marketplace API returns token, I'll wire that into the ingest pipeline and SFDC mapping.
deploy-bot: new doc created: https://redwood.app/sheets/si-handoff (permissions: partnerships + sales) :rocket:
maria (partnerships): OK — next steps: alex to add SFDC fields + validation, raj to update territory owners doc, kelly to publish tech-brief template, sara to draft escalation play. I'll update the partnerships playbook and ping all when live. Anyone object?
sara (si-engage): no objections, schedule a quick 20 min sync tomorrow to finalize wording.
raj (sales): works for me.
alex (salesops): scheduled 11:00 PT tomorrow, invite sent. :calendar:
